description: This Java class, CatalogUrlSeoTransform, is part of the OFBiz framework and handles the creation and transformation of SEO-friendly URLs for product categories and products. It includes methods for generating URLs based on category and product IDs or names, managing category name-ID mappings, and forwarding or rewriting URLs according to configuration and request context. The class integrates with other OFBiz components such as entity querying, URL utilities, and web request handling to produce SEO-optimized URLs.

classes.name: CatalogUrlSeoTransform
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate, transform, and forward SEO-friendly URLs for categories and products within OFBiz framework, with internal mappings and configuration-based URL construction.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from a map of arguments, handling SimpleScalar and GenericObjectModel types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that processes the body of a FreeMarker template transformation, generating SEO URLs based on request context and arguments.

methods.name: isCategoryMapInitialed
methods.description: Checks if the category name-ID and ID-name mappings have been initialized.

methods.name: getCategoryNameIdMap
methods.description: Returns the current map from category names (seo-friendly) to category IDs.

methods.name: getCategoryIdNameMap
methods.description: Returns the current map from category IDs to category names (seo-friendly).

methods.name: initCategoryMap
methods.description: Initializes the category maps by fetching categories from the database and generating seo-friendly URL parts.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Builds a product URL based on request context, product ID, categories, and configuration, ensuring SEO-friendly URL parts.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Builds a category URL with optional URL parameters such as view size, index, sort, and search string, ensuring SEO-friendly structure.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method to construct product URLs in services, using delegator, wrappers, and context parameters.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method to construct category URLs in services, incorporating additional URL parameters.

methods.name: forwardProductUri
methods.description: Forwards incoming HTTP requests for product URLs to internal URLs, matching pattern and optionally controlling servlet.

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: General URI forwarder that rewrites URLs based on category and product patterns and configurations.

methods.name: forwardCategoryUri
methods.description: Specialized forwarding for category-specific URLs, rewriting and dispatching requests.
